title: LOW-BAND WIRE SHAPE GATED: LowWires.lean machine-proves the endpoint's low-band wire configuration - R-wires definitionally zero below the strip, floor = near pin 0.9975, S4 low leg trivial (0 < 0.9975), and lowBandSqueezeShape pins the three nontrivial low-band legs as JOINTLY contradictory (0.9975 <= devStripMin <= Qside <= 0)
body: THE MOVE: the low-band instance of the RHEnd.rh_program78 walk spine is now explicit and machine-proven in formal/RhAttack/LowWires.lean.  The concrete endpoint runs the P1.2 walk at the R-residue wires of S4Asm (BwireR / MrR / MfR) with devProg = S1LowT.devStripMin and the concrete floor floProg (the unified S2 floor on the covered region, the near pin elsewhere).  BELOW THE PROGRAM STRIP (t0 < 1000) the outer regime test (1000 <= t0) of the R-wires fails, so the wire values are DEFINITIONALLY the zero/floor defaults - LowWires pins each of those definitional facts as a lemma: bwireR_low_zero and mrr_low_zero (both R def-side wires = 0 below the strip; the if_neg on the regime test), mfr_zero (the zero-side reduction error wire MfR = 0 everywhere - the R form is exact on the zero side, the residual is carried by the def-side wires), wireSumLow (BwireR + MrR + MfR = 0 below the strip), devProg_low (devProg = devStripMin, definitional), floProg_low_pin (floProg = p8_f_near_pin = 0.9975 below the strip - the covered-region branch of floProg does not fire).  THE SQUEEZE SHAPE (the content): s4low_trivial states the S4 low-band leg standalone (the wire sum 0 is strictly below the near pin 0.9975 - the in-body fact behind RHEnd's hs4low_pin, now a named lemma); lowBandSqueezeShape is the key shape theorem: given the three nontrivial low-band legs (h1 = hs1 the zero side: devStripMin <= Qside, Mf = 0; hpin = hS2low the S2 floor pin: 0.9975 <= devStripMin; h3 = hs3 the def-side wire: Qside <= 0, the zero-wire shape below the strip), the zero-side scale at any low-band off-pair is squeezed 0.9975 <= devStripMin <= Qside <= 0 - JOINTLY CONTRADICTORY (nlinarith after the calc chain).  LIVE-ENGINE status per the liveness audit (discovery 0089): this is the designed squeeze at the low-band wire configuration, not a dead form - the three legs are the checkable data faces (hs1 = the C2 >= side at the audited height + the QSide resid data face, hS2low = the day-030 floor pin datum, hs3 = the zero-wire shape proven here), and their joint inconsistency at an existing low-band off-pair is exactly what excludes such pairs.  It is the low-band sibling of QSide.section8_close_at_audit (discovery 0091), which pins the same shape at the audit-band margin constants.  HONESTY: LEAN-PROVEN (the definitional simplifications + the squeeze shape).  NO RH claim: the legs themselves remain the NAMED residual of the endpoint (they are data faces to be supported, not proven here); LowWires pins only the wire SHAPE they run on.  FULL TREE BUILD GREEN 17450.  ALSO (data, in flight): the s31z2 5e8G ladder - dps-15 (logzeta = +2.9370199551) and dps-20 (logzeta = +1.7289704098) LANDED, peaks 92.6 GB; dps-30 in flight (~1h06m, RSS 95.1 GB); dps-40 (the census channel) last.  The dps15/dps20 spread (~1.2 in log|zeta|, a |zeta| factor ~3.3 at ONE height) is recorded as a precision-sensitivity datum: the 5e8G row certifies only at dps-40 on this protocol.
